article.title: What I’ve been reading
article.excerpt: 1. Michael Crichton, Next . Yes it is "writing-by-numbers," yes it is better than his recent work, but no, it is not nearly as good as Jurassic Park, Sphere (my favorite), Congo , or for that matter his book on Jasper Johns. Some critics like it . The start is OK but it falls apart as it proceeds. By the way, here is my previous post on human-chimp hybrids
